defects.catch_criteria: In scripts/check-intent-corpora.ts, SENTENCE_END counts a terminator only when whitespace plus a sentence opener or the end of the text follows it directly, so a sentence that ends inside a closing quotation mark or bracket (for example `The client says "Stopped."`) is not counted by sentenceCount. A catch must say that sentence endings followed by a closing quote or bracket are missed, so the length rule miscounts: a valid one-sentence statement reads as zero sentences, or a body over four sentences passes.
defects.title: Count sentence endings inside closing quotation marks
